qdisc_dump.r:
qdisc netem 1: root refcnt 17 limit 10000 delay 96us
qdisc tbf 10: parent 1: rate 1Gbit burst 500000b lat 50ms
qdisc_dump.s:
qdisc netem 1: root refcnt 17 limit 10000 delay 96us
qdisc tbf 10: parent 1: rate 1Gbit burst 500000b lat 50ms

loopback_note: delay values are per-interface egress on a veth PAIR; the target is ROUND-TRIP time; never apply these numbers to loopback, which traverses the qdisc twice.
